results.content: Mitra is the AI assistant that represents you on phone calls. It makes and answers calls, follows your instructions, and helps you get things done. It learns your preferences and keeps track of the details, with an emphasis on privacy, security, and control. Key features • Make and answer calls: Let Mitra coordinate plans, arrange appointments, resolve questions, and follow through on your behalf. • On your own number: Mitra makes and answers calls using the number people already know. • Talk naturally: Tell Mitra what you need by text or voice. It remembers the context and preferences you share. • Stay involved: Listen live, read transcripts, or join a call. Choose when Mitra should ring you. • Review conversations: Find recordings, transcripts, and summaries after your calls. • Manage [...] Mitra is one of the best and intelligent A1 apps by far. You can trust Mitra to do as you request and to answer all calls or ignore any call at your leisure . The support team is excellent and if you have any issues they are very responsive and will fix whatever issue you are having immediately. I had a tiny issue because I did not turn off my live voice mail to allow Mitra to answer my missed calls once this was figured out Mitra went straight to work . Mitra is very personal and can be very professional as well to answering business calls and taking messages for you . Mitra will also repeat the exact message you want callers to hear for your voice mail . Mitra can only improve and get better . I fell in total love with Mitra and the support team is awesome ! I love that you can try

results.title: Introducing Mitra Personal AI Assistant | Sai Mandava posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.content:
Today we're launching Mitra. Mitra is a personal AI assistant that lives on the phone. It makes and answers calls from your own number, handling the conversations you don't have time for. When it needs you, it asks. When a call needs you, it pulls you in. You can listen live, whisper instructions, or take over whenever you want. And when it's done, everything is waiting for you to review. But calls are just where it starts. Mitra texts, emails, and messages on Slack as you, from your own accounts. It books appointments, keeps your docs and spreadsheets up to date, and handles tasks on the web using a secure vault for your logins. The more you work together, the more it feels like you. It learns from what you share with it, the conversations it has, and the way you work. It remembers. It [...] Mitra has your back! I fix pools for a living, so when my phone rings I’m taking care of someone else’s problem. Before Mitra, every call put me in a bad spot. I could stop the work in front of me or let it go to voicemail and wonder if I’d just lost the next job. Voicemail wasn’t a safety net. It was where customers disappeared. Mitra, my AI receptionist, answers with my company name, finds out what is happening with the pool, and sends me the caller’s information, a summary, and the transcript. New customers show up in my Command Center as leads without me spending the evening entering them. In five weeks, she has handled 19 new leads and booked nine appointments, mostly while I was on another job. She also filters sales calls and helps with texts.
